input: app.use('/ftp', serveIndexMiddleware, serveIndex('ftp', { icons: true })) // vuln-code-snippet vuln-line directoryListingChallenge

value.reason: The snippet mounts serve-index on /ftp with icons enabled and no authentication middleware, so the directory listing is publicly browsable. This matches the SEC-07 pattern of exposing a directory to the public. The snippet does not show the directory's contents, so whether they include personal data is unconfirmed. The vuln-code-snippet markers suggest an intentionally vulnerable training app, which still makes this a real exposure for triage purposes.
